# 1) Read in File and Make Plotting Function ====
This section of the code reads in the file and makes the function that makes the plots.
```{r}
#Set plot directories
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)

#Set results file
results_file="C:/Users/mconery/Box/Mitchell_Work_Files/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Data/1000G_Simulations/genotype_beta_correlation_deviation_metrics.csv"
#Output directory
out_dir<- "C:/Users/mconery/Box/Mitchell_Work_Files/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Figures/Correlation_Structure"
#Read in the results file
input_df <- read.csv(results_file)
#Set factors for buckets
input_df$bucket_range <- factor(input_df$bucket_range, levels = c("0.0-1.0","0.0-0.2","0.2-0.4","0.4-0.6","0.6-0.8","0.8-1.0","0.0-0.1","0.1-0.2", "0.2-0.3", "0.3-0.4","0.4-0.5"))

#Set function
plot_simulation_results <- function(inp_df, 
                                   x_var, x_label,
                                   y_var, y_label,
                                   color_var = NULL, color_var_label = NULL,
                                   filter_bucket = "overall",
                                   filter_trait_type = NULL,
                                   filter_n_causal = NULL,
                                   facet_var = NULL, plot_title=NULL,
                                   save_path = NULL) {
  # Read results data
  df <- inp_df
  
  if(!is.null(filter_bucket)){
    df <- df %>% filter(bucket_type %in% filter_bucket)
  }
  # Apply optional filters
  if (!is.null(filter_trait_type)) {
    df <- df %>% filter(trait_type %in% filter_trait_type)
  }
  if (!is.null(filter_n_causal)) {
    df <- df %>% filter(n_causal %in% filter_n_causal)
  }
  
  # Create base plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = x_var, y = y_var, color = color_var)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    theme_pubr(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label
    ) + theme(legend.position = "right") + 
    labs(color = color_var_label)
    
  
  # Faceting
  if (!is.null(facet_var)) {
    p <- p + facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", facet_var)), scales = "free_x")
  }
  
  # Handle numeric vs categorical x-variables
  if (is.numeric(df[[x_var]])) {
    p <- p + scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma)
  } else {
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  }
  
  print(p)
  #Save if requested
  if (!(is.null(save_path))) {
    ggsave(
      filename   = save_path,
      plot       = p,
      width      = 200,
      height     = 80,
      units      = "mm",
      dpi        = 300,       # or 600 if required
      compression = "lzw"     # optional, shrinks file size
    )
  }

}

```
# 2) Make basic plot colored by # of causal variants ====
```{r}

plot_simulation_results(input_df, x_var="n_traits", y_var="mae", color_var="n_causal", filter_bucket = "overall", 
                        facet_var="population", x_label="# Traits", y_label="Mean Absolute Error (MAE)", color_var_label="# Causal\nVariants",
                        save_path = paste(out_dir, "MAE.by_trait.colored_num_causal.tiff", sep = "/"))

```
# 3) Make basic plot colored by effect size ====
```{r}

plot_simulation_results(input_df, x_var="n_traits", y_var="mae", color_var="effect_size", filter_bucket = "overall", 
                        facet_var="population", x_label="# Traits", y_label="Mean Absolute Error (MAE)", color_var_label="Causal\nVariant\nEffect\nSize",
                        save_path = paste(out_dir, "MAE.by_trait.colored_effect_size.tiff", sep = "/"))

```

# 4) Make Plot of Genotype Correlation Buckets ====
```{r}

plot_simulation_results(input_df, x_var="bucket_range", y_var="mae", color_var="n_traits", filter_bucket = "geno_corr", filter_trait_type = "continuous",
                        facet_var="population", x_label = "Genotype Correlation", y_label="Mean Absolute Error (MAE)", color_var_label="# Traits",
                        save_path = paste(out_dir, "MAE.by_genotype_bucket.colored_traits.tiff", sep = "/"))

```

# 5) Make Plot of MAF Buckets ====
```{r}

plot_simulation_results(input_df, x_var="bucket_range", y_var="mae", color_var="n_traits", filter_bucket = "maf", filter_trait_type = "continuous", 
                        filter_n_causal = 0, facet_var="population",
                        x_label = "Minor Allele Frequency (MAF)", y_label="Mean Absolute Error (MAE)", color_var_label="# Traits",
                        save_path = paste(out_dir, "MAE.by_maf_bucket.colored_traits.tiff", sep = "/"))

```

# 6) Make Table of Continuous Trait Standard Errors ====
```{r}
#Set output file location
out_file <- "C:/Users/mconery/Box/Mitchell_Work_Files/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Data/1000G_Simulations/correlation_error_standard_deviations.csv"
#Filter and write file
input_df %>% filter(trait_type == "continuous" & bucket_type == "geno_corr") %>% group_by(n_traits, bucket_range) %>% summarize(stddev_error=mean(stddev_error, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% write.csv(file=out_file, col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, sep = ",")
```

# 11) Make High-Quality Figure for Grant Application ====
```{r}

df <- input_df
x_var="n_traits"
y_var="mae"
filter_bucket = "overall"
filter_trait_type = "continuous"
color_var="n_causal"
filter_n_causal = NULL
facet_var="population"
#Set function
plot_title=NULL

if(!is.null(filter_bucket)){
  df <- df %>% filter(bucket_type %in% filter_bucket)
}
# Apply optional filters
if (!is.null(filter_trait_type)) {
  df <- df %>% filter(trait_type %in% filter_trait_type)
}
if (!is.null(filter_n_causal)) {
  df <- df %>% filter(n_causal %in% filter_n_causal)
}

# Create base plot
p <- ggplot(df %>% filter(population=="ALL"), aes_string(x = x_var, y = y_var, color = color_var)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = plot_title,
    x = "# Traits",
    y = "Mean Absolute Error (MAE)", 
    color = "# Causal\nVariants"
  )

# Faceting
if (!is.null(facet_var)) {
  p <- p + facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", facet_var)), scales = "free_x")
}

# Handle numeric vs categorical x-variables
p <- p + scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) + 
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size=11),
               strip.text = element_blank(),
                legend.position = c(1, 1),
                legend.title = element_text(size=11, hjust = 0.75),
                legend.justification = c(1, 1),
                legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", size = 0.25))

ggsave("C:/Users/mconery/Box/Mitchell_Work_Files/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Figures/Correlation_Structure/MAE.high-res.ALL_pop_only.jpeg", plot = p, width = 2.25, height = 3, units = "in",dpi = 300)

```
